findings.change: None required; if carry measures should exclude diagnostics, skip entries under an alone/ directory in carryMeasures.
findings.claim: The carry process-measure now counts the diagnostic alone reruns as attest steps, because the walker that collects carry check executions is recursive and the new alone directories carry their own observation.json files.
findings.evidence: internal/launch/check_evidence.go ReadCheckExecutions walks the whole artifacts/unit-checks/carry root and accepts any observation.json whose executionId equals its directory name; internal/launch/unit_check.go execute writes observation.json for the alone-* execution. The unit run's own alone rerun is likewise a measured launch, so the extra minutes are consistent with the unit run; no reader breaks. Slice works and is safe without a change.

findings.change: None required; if desired, treat a retained alone exit of -1 as not completed so a fresh alone attempt runs.
findings.claim: A timed-out alone rerun is retained with a complete result.json and is reused on every later carry invocation as 'environment' evidence, so the only way to attempt the rerun again is --rerun of the whole check.
findings.evidence: intent_carry_check.go completed() accepts any result.json with one exit and equal selectors regardless of exit code; a -1 exit makes run.Exited false and ClassifyRed answers 'environment'. The unit run has the same stickiness (rerunAlone returns early when alone.Outcome is 'environment'), and the refusal names the --rerun remedy, so the hand route is not stuck.

findings.evidence: intent_carry_flake_test.go covers fresh flake, reuse, interrupted rerun, red-stays-red and unnamed red; check_test.go covers 'flake with red audits' at the validator.
